macros.name: pgfcalendar
macros.doc: This command can be used to typeset a calendar.

macros.name: pgfcalendarcurrentday
macros.doc: The day of month of the current date (always two digits).

macros.name: pgfcalendareastersunday
macros.doc: This command computes the date of Easter Sunday as a Julian date and stores it in ⟨counter⟩.

macros.name: pgfcalendarifdate
macros.doc: This command is used to execute code based on properties of ⟨date⟩.

macros.name: pgfcalendarjuliantodate
macros.doc: This command converts a Julian day number to an ISO-date.

macros.name: pgfcalendarjuliantoweekday
macros.doc: This command converts a Julian day to a week day by computing the day modulo 7.

macros.name: pgfcalendarmonthname
macros.doc: This command expands to a textual representation of the month, which is given by the ⟨month number⟩.

macros.name: pgfcalendarsuggestedname
macros.doc: This macro expands to a suggested name for nodes representing days in a calendar.

macros.name: pgfcalendarweekdayname
macros.doc: This command expands to a textual representation of the day of week, given by the ⟨week day number⟩.
